about_the_game:
Deskcat is a cute and lively desktop companion game that brings your computer to life with an adorable animated cat! Designed to add a touch of joy and playfulness to your daily routine, Deskcat is more than just a simple decoration — it’s an interactive mascot that responds to your actions in real time.

This cheerful orange tabby cat lives right on your desktop, staying with you while you browse the web, do homework, or play games. One of Deskcat’s most charming features is its ability to follow your mouse pointer with curiosity and energy. Wherever your cursor goes, Deskcat’s eyes and head will track it attentively — like a real pet chasing after a toy!

Features:

  • 🐾 A fully animated cat that lives on your desktop

  • 🎵 Reacts to sound: dances when music or audio is playing

  • 🖱️ Tracks and follows your mouse cursor across the screen

  • 🌟 Lightweight and easy to run in the background

  • 😺 Designed to make you smile, whether you're working or relaxing

Deskcat is the perfect blend of charm and simplicity. It's not just a virtual pet — it’s your loyal little buddy on-screen, always ready to move, groove, and keep you company. Whether you’re a cat lover, need a break during your study sessions, or just want something delightful to look at while working, Deskcat is here to brighten your desktop.
